method: Read listed skills/reference sections as build-time material; reconciled rules locally. Scope explicitly distinguishes full reading, selected sections, and heading inventory. No upstream native app or source example conformance claimed.

inspected_files.scope: gates, report format and candidate examples
first 100 lines: platform, runtime, tool and property decisions
first 100 lines: toaster props, toast options and functions
section heading inventory only; no Swift implementation imported

source_map.retained: Purpose, predictability, agency, direct response, physical continuity, spatial consistency, typography and material hierarchy

source_map.modified: Viewing Importance explicitly marked as conservative Fluidity extension; no mandated brand or glass

source_map.retained: Immediate keyboard/frequent interactions; named purpose; data readability and restrained rare delight
